title: Potential risk
one_line_definition: Total HCC risk weight across all conditions (regardless of documentation status) divided by the patient count of Documented conditions only, representing the potential risk per documented patient.
numerator_meaning: The sum of HCC risk weights across all conditions including Documented, Undocumented, and Suspected flags.
denominator_meaning: The total patient count restricted to Documented conditions only — conditions that have been coded at a clinical encounter.
result_meaning: The average total HCC risk weight per documented patient, reflecting the full potential risk burden including unconfirmed and predicted conditions relative to the documented patient base.
scope_note: Numerator includes all flag values (Documented, Undocumented, and Suspected); denominator is restricted to Documented rows only.

measure_meanings.Potential risk: Total HCC risk value across all documentation statuses divided by the patient count of Documented conditions, showing the potential risk per documented patient.
measure_meanings.Potential risk YoY Card: Displays the year-over-year percentage change in Potential risk compared to the same period last year, formatted as an upward or downward arrow with percentage.
